generateScript

public void generateScript(java.lang.String dirName,
                           java.lang.String scriptName,
                           java.lang.String xmlDir,
                           org.w3c.dom.Node root)
                    throws MalformedScriptException
Generates a script (and possible sub-scripts) given a base name from which to derive more script names, and a root Node to start at (the node should be called "script"). This is the default behavior option and generates a non-linear script if possible.

Parameters:
dirName - the directory path up to the directory the script exists in
scriptName - the base name for the script to create, like "script"
root - the root Node (under the Document node) for the XML tree to be turned into a script
MalformedScriptException

chmod

public int chmod(java.lang.String filename,
                 java.lang.String permissions)
          throws MalformedScriptException
A useful helper function which performs chmod on the filename provided setting it to the permissions provided. User beware: there is no checking on either provided String.

Parameters:
filename - the name of the file to chmod
permissions - new permissions for the file (you could put any other options in this String as well)
Returns:
the return value of the Process.waitFor() where the Process is generated from Runtime.exec("chmod " + permissions + " " + filename). In other words, should be the return value from system call chmod().
MalformedScriptException

main

public static void main(java.lang.String[] args)
Runs the ScriptGenerator with the provided arguments. arg 1: name of XML file to generate script(s) from. arg 2: directory to put scripts in arg 3: base name for scripts arg 4&5 (optional): -pl DEBUG_LEVEL

Parameters:
args - the command line arguments
